strings.本站没有你要的问题？把它描述出来：解长什么样（编码），好坏怎么算（目标函数）。其: Does the site not have your problem? Describe it: what a solution looks like (the encoding) and how good it is (the objective function). Everything else — dozens of algorithms, convergence curves, result export and reproduction — is ready-made.
strings.所有算法都只通过两样东西和问题打交道：解的形状（编码）和目标值。所以你只要给出这: Every algorithm deals with a problem through just two things: the shape of a solution (the encoding) and the objective value. So if you supply these two, the same algorithms run your problem unchanged:
strings.位向量：n 个是/否的决策——选哪些渠道、开哪些仓库、用哪些特征。: Bit vector: n yes/no decisions — which channels to pick, which warehouses to open, which features to use.
strings.排列：把 0..n-1 排个顺序——任务先后、路线顺序、装配次序。: Permutation: an ordering of 0..n−1 — task order, route order, assembly sequence.
strings.实数向量：n 个在 lo~hi 之间的数——参数调优、曲线拟合、函数最小化。: Real vector: n numbers between lo and hi — parameter tuning, curve fitting, function minimisation.
strings.先在下面的「实例」里选一个示例，改成你自己的，点「检查并载入」。检查时会在 30: First pick an example under “Instance” below, edit it into your own, and press “Check and load”. The check tries your objective function on 30 random solutions and points out where it is wrong.
strings.数值范围 lo ~ hi（每一维共用）: Value range lo ~ hi (shared by all dimensions)
strings.数据表（JSON：名字 → 数字或数字数组，最多三层；目标函数里直接用名字读取）: Data table (JSON: name → number or array of numbers, at most three levels; the objective function reads them by name)
strings.目标函数（用 x 表示解，n 表示长度）: Objective function (x is the solution, n is the length)
strings.目标函数怎么写？（语法与限制）: How do I write the objective function? (syntax and limits)
strings.写法像 Python 的表达式：可以有几行 名字 = 表达式 的中间量，最后一行: Write it like a Python expression: you may have a few lines of intermediate values name = expression, and the last line is the objective value itself (or write objective = …).
strings.不可用：import、点号属性、字符串、lambda、字典 / 集合、for /: Not allowed: import, dotted attributes, strings, lambda, dictionaries / sets, for / while statements, def. Loops can be nested at most two levels.
strings.约束请用罚函数：违反约束就加一个大数 × 违反量，例如 gain - 100 *: For constraints use a penalty function: add a large number × the violation when a constraint is broken, for example gain - 100 * max(0, spend - budget).
strings.我的目标函数会被当作代码执行吗？: Will my objective function be executed as code?
strings.不会。目标函数只是一段「表达式」：本站先把它解析成语法树，逐个节点检查，只放行数: No. The objective function is only an “expression”: the site parses it into a syntax tree and checks every node, allowing only numbers, arithmetic and powers, comparisons, comprehensions and a short whitelist of functions such as sum / min / max / abs / sqrt; import, attribute access (dots), strings, lambda and loop statements are all rejected. Only after parsing does it compile into a tiny arithmetic-only program, and each evaluation also has caps on iteration count and integer size, so a formula cannot freeze the tab.
strings.为什么没有 for 循环、while 循环？: Why are there no for or while loops?
strings.表达式风格的 sum(… for i in range(n)) 已经能写出绝大多: Expression-style sum(… for i in range(n)) can already write most objective functions (sums, max/min, penalty terms), and the loop depth and count are limited so it cannot run forever. If your objective really needs full Python (recursion, complex state), use the command line: python swarm.py solve data.json --domain custom --objective-py your_function.py — that runs your own file on your own computer.
strings.用罚函数：违反约束就在目标里加一个大数乘以违反量，如 gain - 100 *: Use a penalty function: when a constraint is broken, add a large number times the violation to the objective, e.g. gain - 100 * max(0, spend - budget). If the penalty is too light the algorithm will pick cheap solutions that break the constraint; if too heavy there is no gradient between feasible and infeasible. The “choose channels within a budget” example uses exactly this style — edit it and try.
strings.为什么三种编码对应的算法数不一样？: Why do the three encodings have different numbers of algorithms?
strings.每种编码复用本站已有的一批内核：位向量用 QUBO 那批，排列用装箱 / 图着色: Each encoding reuses a batch of kernels already on the site: bit vectors use the QUBO set, permutations use the bin-packing / graph-colouring set, and real vectors use the continuous-function set. The kernels were not written for your problem, but they only touch it through the “encoding” and the “objective value”, so they run unchanged. An algorithm is not necessarily right for your problem — pick several and compare.
strings.「最优值」是算法在你的目标函数上找到的最好值，不保证是全局最优。随机算法换个种子: The “best value” is the best the algorithm found on your objective function and is not guaranteed to be globally optimal. Stochastic algorithms give different results with another seed; try several seeds before concluding anything. The exported result file carries the full problem definition, so others can reproduce it with python swarm.py replay.
strings.「什么问题能变成什么问题」的地图：归约（A ≤ₚ B，会解 B 就会解 A）、等: A map of “what turns into what”: reductions (A ≤ₚ B: if you can solve B you can solve A), equivalences, special cases and generalisations. Check this graph before choosing a method — your problem is probably an avatar of some classic problem.
strings.元启发式文献里新问题层出不穷，但底层互相归约。看懂两条路：特例（你的问题是经典问: New problems appear constantly in the metaheuristics literature, but underneath they reduce to one another. Understand two directions: special case (your problem is a special case of a classic one, so use its algorithms directly) and reduction (your problem contains a classic problem as a special case, so its hardness is a lower bound). Every relation comes with its original reference.

strings.划分 ≡ₚ 2-箱装箱：箱数固定 k=2（每箱容量 Σ/2）时，「能否平分成两堆: Partition ≡ₚ 2-bin packing: with the number of bins fixed at k = 2 (each of capacity Σ/2), “can the numbers be split into two equal piles” and “can they fit into 2 bins” are the same decision problem and the reduction holds both ways — in plain words, number partitioning is 2-bin packing. But general k-bin packing (k part of the input) is strongly NP-hard (G&J SR1), whereas partition itself is only weakly NP-complete (solvable by pseudo-polynomial DP) — the strong/weak gap is exactly why this equivalence cannot be extrapolated to k > 2
strings.Martello & Toth (1990) 找零问题专章: Martello & Toth (1990), chapter on the change-making problem
strings.一维装箱是变尺寸箱装箱（VSBPP）的特例：所有箱子容量取同一值，尺寸维度消失。: One-dimensional bin packing is a special case of variable-sized bin packing (VSBPP): all bins get the same capacity and the size dimension vanishes. VSBPP is the more general problem
strings.一维装箱是二维装箱的特例：所有物品高度取同一值（条带高度=1），二维退化为一条线: One-dimensional bin packing is a special case of two-dimensional bin packing: all items have the same height (strip height = 1) and two dimensions degenerate into a line. The two-dimensional problem is the more general one
strings.列表全部相同时退化为经典点着色: When all lists are identical it reduces to classic vertex colouring
strings.SAT 是「目标=全部子句满足」的 MAX-SAT 特例: SAT is the special case of MAX-SAT where the goal is to satisfy all clauses
